skeleton_text: MATCH (p:HOLE_LABEL_1)-[:HOLE_REL_TYPE_1]->(:HOLE_LABEL_2) CALL { WITH p MATCH (p)-[:HOLE_REL_TYPE_2]->(f:HOLE_LABEL_3) RETURN f.HOLE_PROP_1 AS HOLE_ALIAS_1 LIMIT HOLE_LIMIT } MERGE (p)-[:HOLE_REL_TYPE_3]->(f:HOLE_LABEL_4 { HOLE_PROP_2: HOLE_ALIAS_1 }) RETURN p.HOLE_PROP_3 AS HOLE_ALIAS_2, HOLE_ALIAS_1
